description: Short interest / ADV, sector-ranked, factor-residualised, quintile long-short

signal.comment: heavily shorted names underperform (Boehmer, Jones & Zhang). orientation fixed from the literature, not from the sample.

construction.legs: long top quintile, short bottom quintile
construction.weighting: equal within bucket, sectors equally weighted

costs.model: tick floor + inverse-sqrt-volume, anchored to 2bp for large caps
costs.charged: both sides, both legs, at each stock's own half-spread

backtest.verdict: fails the luck bar on sample size; frozen to find out if that changes with data that did not exist at freeze time

live_sizing.comment: deliberately small. this is a measurement, not a position. sizing is a parameter of the record, so changing it later requires a new version.

REFUTED.reason: backtest sample was truncated by a pagination bug in the ingest. the API returns data to 2017-12-29; the first pull stopped at 2021-03 and that truncation was mistaken for a FINRA retention limit.
REFUTED.status: abandoned. the manifest is kept so the record shows what was frozen, what it claimed, and how it was refuted.
